subject: Stirge
picture: A stirge hangs upside down from a cave beam. Mosquito-bat body, two leathery wings, four small hanging legs, and a long thin needle snout like a drinking straw. Not a dragon, not a cute baby dinosaur, not a giant bat. Cave ceiling with simple beams, rock walls, large floor stones, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
